{{< video videos/molecular_tools_styling.mp4 >}}

Residue colours that blend in with `t.recolor`, callouts on 2K39, the rest of the chain
faded with `t.fade`, a `com_distance` ruler between two Cα atoms that updates as the
ensemble plays, and a surface that follows the coordinates.

ProteinMotion's second scene has hydrogen-bond rulers, which are in the
[alpha helix storyboard](alpha_helix_hbonds.qmd), and screened electrostatic contacts,
which need a planned `Coulomb Contacts` node; it is left as a comment.

After ProteinMotion's [`molecular_tools.py`](https://github.com/pdpppd/proteinmotion/blob/main/examples/molecular_tools.py).

## Script

Run it with `uv run python docs/examples/timeline/scripts/molecular_tools.py out_dir`; set
`MN_EXAMPLES_QUICK=1` for a small, fast check. The script is included from the file:

```{.python filename="scripts/molecular_tools.py"}
{{< include scripts/molecular_tools.py >}}
```
